definitions.explanation: To personally go through or participate in an experience.

examples.japanese: {寺院|じいん}で{座禅|ざぜん}を{体験|たいけん}した。
examples.english: I experienced Zen meditation at the temple.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{文化|ぶんか}を{体験|たいけん}したい。
examples.english: I want to experience Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{地震|じしん}を{体験|たいけん}した。
examples.english: I experienced an earthquake for the first time.

notes:
{体験|たいけん}する means to personally experience something firsthand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体験|たいけん}する: to experience
- {体験|たいけん}できる: can experience
- {体験|たいけん}{学習|がくしゅう}: hands-on learning
- {体験|たいけん}{談|だん}: personal account
- {体験|たいけん}{入学|にゅうがく}: trial enrollment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経験|けいけん}する: to experience (broader, includes accumulated experience)
- {体験|たいけん}: emphasizes direct, firsthand experience

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{体験|たいけん}する
